entities.name: István Nemere
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: István Nemere was a Hungarian novelist, Esperantist, and translator. He wrote 744 published books up to November 2020, mostly in Hungarian, over twenty novels in Esperanto. He has been a notable figure in the world of Hungarian science fiction with as many as 60 novels and several stories.

entities.summary: István Nemere was a Hungarian novelist, Esperantist, and translator. He wrote 744 published books up to November 2020, mostly in Hungarian, over twenty novels in Esperanto. He has been a notable figure in the world of Hungarian science fiction with as many as 60 novels and several stories.
